title: Renal chemistry context and hemoglobin: a negative NHANES-to-Indian-cohort transport test
abstract: A source-standardized log-urea-nitrogen × log-creatinine interaction did not demonstrate better external hemoglobin prediction than flexible additive chemistry: NHANES-to-UCI added-minus-base MSE +0.1004 (g/dL)², joint-bootstrap 95% interval [-0.2701, 1.2673].
